definitions.explanation: A duration of one night, typically from evening to morning.

examples.japanese: {一晩|ひとばん}⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
{一晩|ひとばん}⟦{寝|ね}かせて→寝かせる：12322_nekaseru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let it sit overnight before eating.

examples.japanese: {一晩|ひとばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to finish it in one night.

notes:
{一晩|ひとばん} refers to the duration of one night.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一晩|ひとばん}⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay one night
- {一晩|ひとばん}⟦{寝|ね}かせる→寝かせる：12322_nekaseru⟧: to let sit overnight
- {一晩|ひとばん}{中|じゅう}: all night long ({一晩中|ひとばんじゅう})
- {一晩|ひとばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in one night
- {一晩|ひとばん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: taking one night

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {二晩|ふたばん}: two nights
- {何晩|なんばん}: how many nights
- ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧: every night

The related term {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう} means "all night long" or "throughout the night."
